name: hearth
description: Manage your household's recipes, meal plan, grocery catalog, and shopping list with Hearth.

interface.longDescription: Plan meals from saved recipes, organize collections, review NYT Cooking imports, and prepare a shopping list with scaled quantities and package counts. Hearth connects to one shared household; changes affect everyone in it. Only authorized household members can connect. Grocery prices, ordering, nutritional analysis, and browser-local kitchen timers are not supported. Review ingredient warnings and dietary suitability before cooking.
defaultPrompt: Help me plan dinners from my saved recipes for a specific week.
Find a recipe in my collection and help me update it.
Build a shopping list for my planned meals and flag amounts to review.
